hotels.title: Stylish Brisbane Fortitude Valley City Break with Heated Skyline Pool
hotels.description: Escape in style to this modern urban oasis, perfectly located in the heart of Fortitude Valley, Brisbane’s entertainment hub, just a short drive from James Street. From its central location, explore a wealth of wonderful sights nearby, including The Tivoli and the lively local areas of Chinatown, Newstead and New Farm. This stylish retreat has everything you need for a sensational city break - dive into the heated skyline pool, keep up your routine at the fully-equipped fitness centre or smash your step count as you explore vibrant King Street. When it's time to retreat to your elegant room, indulge in a blend of upscale sophistication and inner-city living.
